messages:
maria: Hey support, noticed some negative tokens/sec and a few TTFT windows showing -1 for acme-prod in the console since last kafka restart. Dashboard shows gaps too. Anyone seen this pattern?

aj: can you paste the console screenshot or the raw metric sample? which route/model?

maria: attaching snippet from the raw rollup: ```
{
  "window_start": 1719987000,
  "tokens_per_sec": -4.2,
  "ttft_ms": -1
}
{
  "window_start": 1719987060,
  "tokens_per_sec": 0.0,
  "ttft_ms": 320
}
``` route: /v1/generate, model: rw-large-quant. Seen across 3 shards in us-east-1.

devin: negative values usually mean a rollup/offset mismatch or consumer duplication in the streaming pipeline. Did we restart the kafka consumer around that time?

sre_jordan: ingest-bot reported a consumer group rebalance and a restart of kv-consumer-3 at 2024-06-03T04:27:42Z. deploy-bot shows an autoscaler evict at 2024-06-03T04:26:58Z.
ingest-bot: consumer-group=kvcache-streams-group, offset reset=earliest -> 0 entries reprocessed: 3127, restart_kind=graceful

aj: ok, likely cause: duplicate messages reprocessed then rollup aggregation logic had a checkpointing gap so deltas went negative. Can you grab the raw per-shard counters for that minute? run: ```sql
SELECT shard, window_start, tokens, tokens_delta FROM streaming_rollups WHERE window_start >= 1719987000 AND window_start <= 1719987200 AND route='/v1/generate';
```

maria: running now, sending top 5 rows: ```
shard=1, window=1719987000, tokens=10234, tokens_delta=-128
shard=2, window=1719987000, tokens=20500, tokens_delta=-256
shard=3, window=1719987060, tokens=0, tokens_delta=0
```

devin: that delta negative confirms a checkpoint rollback or double-count correction during replay. We should not emit negative tokens_per_sec to the console; we should floor at 0 and generate a backfill to recompute rollups for the affected windows.

aj: agree. Short-term mitigation: patch the rollup exporter to clamp negatives to 0 for public metrics and mark as 'under investigation' in the dashboard. Long-term: replay/backfill job to recompute from committed offsets, then stop emitting clamped values.

sre_jordan: creating an incident ticket and scheduling backfill. ticket: INC-2024-2273. Backfill window: 1719986940 -> 1719987240 across shards 1-4. ETA for backfill run: 2h.

maria: customer impacted reported inflated per-token billing anomalies (their cost dashboard shows strange dips). Need notes for billing team so we can avoid incorrect charges.

support-bot: escalate created to billing: TAG=billing-acme, INCIDENT=INC-2024-2273, priority=high

devin: repro notes for eng-runtime: 1) produce a consumer group rebalance by restarting kv-consumer on a shard, 2) ensure streaming-aggregator has a pre-checkpoint message, 3) observe rollup negative deltas in the window following restart. Logs: ```
[2024-06-03T04:27:41Z] kvcache-kvconsumer3: heartbeat lost, triggering rebalance
[2024-06-03T04:27:42Z] kvcache-kvconsumer3: shutdown complete
[2024-06-03T04:27:44Z] streaming-aggregator: detected missing checkpoint for shard=2, window=1719987000
[2024-06-03T04:27:45Z] rollup-writer: wrote delta=-256 for shard=2, window=1719987000
```

aj: I'll open a runtime PR to clamp emitted tokens/sec and add an alert when any rollup delta < 0. Also include a one-click backfill job in the console (for support use).

sre_jordan: running the backfill now (job id bf-171998-01). I'll post progress logs here.

maria: thanks. please keep customer-sms looped in. I'll file the billing adjustment request after backfill completes. :pray:

support-bot: backfill bf-171998-01 started at 2024-06-03T06:05:02Z

sre_jordan: backfill completed, recomputed windows show tokens_per_sec >= 0 and ttft_ms restored. Closing incident when billing confirms.

maria: confirmed with acme that their billing balances look normal now. closing on our side. :tada:
